The '''''Mercenary's Honor''''' was a [[XR Light Transport]] owned by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Sanlo Raal]]. The ship was often referred to by the [[Raal's Regulators]] as "the Honor." Most of its cargo space was converted into troop compartments, with extra weapons, communication systems, and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] added to make it a mobile troop carrier and field base.<ref name="Codex" />
